title: At first this was the best soap dispensing dish brush I ever used; but then it failed after a few weeks
text:
At first this was the best soap dispensing dish brush I ever used; but then it failed after a few weeks. REVISION OF REVIEW IS IN THE UPDATES AT THE BOTTOM

I am really impressed with this soap dispensing sink brush. It fact it is the best I ever tried but I only started using it so time will tell.

WHAT I LIKE

- This is so easy to fill. I just lightly pulled up the plug in the handle to fill it with dish detergent and then pressed down to seal the plug in place.

- One push on the center button and a 5 to 25-cent-sized dollop of soap is dispensed.

- The handle is long and has a nice grip for ease of use.

- The brush bristles are slightly stiff for moderate cleaning.

- The brush head is removable by twisting it to the left to dislodge.

- There's a scraper on the underside of the brush; it's not something I would likely use but it's nice to know it's there if needed.

- The brush comes with a limited lifetime warranty but one has to pay to ship the brush back to them for a replacement.

WHAT I DISLIKE

- I do wish that I could dispense a smaller quantity of soap for the times I'm just cleaning one plate.

- The brush head is not stiff enough for heavy-duty cleaning as the advertising states. I actually like that it's not heavy duty because then the bristles would be too stiff. What I don't like is that they advertise it can be used for that.

- I do not understand why the brush head needs to be replaceable. Perhaps I am wrong, but I seriously doubt the sealing ability of the plug in the handle will outlast the brush head. I would think this whole unit would have to be replaced after a year of use but only time will tell.

If this brush continues to work as it does now, I plan on ordering another one if the price is right. At the time of this review there is no price listed on Amazon. This brush allows me to clean most of my dishes without even getting my hands fully wet. It's great for moderate cleaning. It's not so great for heavy-duty cleaning or for cleaning small items like baked-on-cheese-covered utensils or greasy items like a butter dish where a sponge covers a better surface area. However, I never expect any dish brush to clean items where rubbing with a sponge would normally be required.

UPDATE Feb 8 - I've been using this brush daily all day long and I decided to lower my rating from 4 to 3 stars. Yesterday was the first time I was unable to dispense the soap. It appears that it might be due to too many soap bubbles in the handle but I can't be sure. After playing around a bit I got it to work. Until yesterday it was working beautifully all day long.

UPDATE Feb 11 - I've decided to downgrade this to 2 stars. Today the soap dispensing ability has mostly stopped working. I had to keep opening and closing it to try to get the soap to squirt out using the air in the handle which they call "air displacement" technology. Unfortunately, I can no longer recommend this.

description: This Sabatier Black textured bristle brush is ready to tackle the toughest cleanup jobs. Designed to fit comfortably in the hand with a textured handle for a secure grip, this brush features nylon bristles for performance and durability. The built-in scraper provides the extra strength needed for stuck-on food. Dishwasher safe.
